comments_text: Sequence analysis: APD analysis reveals that this sequence is similar (96.3%) to Bombinin-like peptide 7. A: 22%, L=G: 19%, S=K: 11%. GRAVY: 0.4; mol Wt: 2581.991; mol formula: C115H194N32O34; mol ex coeff: 0. Chemical modification: C-terminal amidation. Activity: active against S. aureus ATCC 6538 or MRSA NCTC 12493 (MIC 4-8 uM), E. faecalis NCTC 12697 (MIC 64 uM), E. coli ATCC 8739 (MIC 2 uM), K. pneumoniae ATCC 43816 (MIC 8 uM), P. aeruginosa ATCC 9027 (MIC 8 uM), and A. baumannii BAA 747 (MIC 16 uM). Structure: random coil in NH4Ac solution and helical in 50% TFE. In vitro toxicity: horse RBC: HC50 111.9 uM, less hemo.lytic.
reference_text: Probiotics Antimicrob Proteins. 2025 Apr 29. doi: 10.1007/s12602-025-10542-1. PubMed
title: Discovery and Optimisation of Novel Bombinin-Derived Peptides from Bombina variegata against Staphylococcus aureus.

comments_text: Sequence analysis: APD analysis reveals that this sequence is similar (95%) to Bombinin H5. L: 30%, G: 25%. GRAVY: 1.49;; mol Wt:1918.435; mol formula: C91H164N22O22; mol ex coeff: 0. Chemical modification: C-terminal amidation. Activity: active against S. aureus ATCC 6538 or 5 strains MRSA NCTC 12493 (MIC 2-8 uM), E. faecalis NCTC 12697 (MIC 8 uM), E. coli ATCC 8739 (MIC 4 uM), K. pneumoniae ATCC 43816 (MIC 8 uM), P. aeruginosa ATCC 9027 (MIC 8 uM), and A. baumannii BAA 747 (MIC 32 uM). MBC is the same or higher than MIC. MOA:bacteria:S. aureus: permeated bacterial membranes and depolarized bacterial membranes. Structure: random coil in NH4Ac solution and helical in 50% TFE. In vitro toxicity: horse RBC: HC50 17.2 uM, hemolytic. Cytotoxicity: Human HaCaT keratinocytes: TC50 29.8 uM. Antimicrobial robustness: NaCl-sensitive:S. aureus MRSA (150 mM); MgCl2-insensitive:S. aureus MRSA (1 mM); KCl-insensitive:S. aureus MRSA (4.5 mM); CaCl2-insensitive:S. aureus MRSA (2 mM). fetal bovine serum-insensitive (10%).
reference_text: Probiotics Antimicrob Proteins. 2025 Apr 29. doi: 10.1007/s12602-025-10542-1. PubMed
title: Discovery and Optimisation of Novel Bombinin-Derived Peptides from Bombina variegata against Staphylococcus aureus.
